subject: Orbit Clinic - Activation Week scheduling and owner matrix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit Clinic - Activation Week scheduling and owner matrix

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference for Orbit Clinic's inference rollout. To get the activation week scheduled we want to lock a 90-minute kickoff that covers product orientation, SSO/data access, and the implementation plan (sprint0). Below are three 90-minute windows — please pick the one that works best for your team, and tell us who will join from your side so we can finalize the attendee lanes. All times in PDT (UTC-7):

Option A: Tue Jul 9, 10:00–11:30
Option B: Wed Jul 10, 13:00–14:30
Option C: Thu Jul 11, 08:00–09:30

Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Karthik Iyer — AE (onboarding owner + program lead)
- Monica Patel — Implementation Manager (SSO, runbook, tech preflight)
- Jonas Weber — Solutions Engineer (data access, infra checklist)

Agenda (90 minutes):
1) 00–10m — Introductions & goals for activation week
2) 10–35m — Product orientation & tech overview (Jonas)
3) 35–55m — SSO & access requirements (Monica)
4) 55–75m — Sprint0 plan, milestones, and guardrails (Karthik)
5) 75–85m — Q&A and parking-lot items
6) 85–90m — Next steps / calendar cadences

Prework request (short):
- Please share the list of users requiring admin access and an SSO contact.
- If possible, attach a sample data schema for the inference call flow (anonymized).

Attachments: orbit-onboarding-playbook.pdf (summary of activation week flow)
Tentative calendar invite will be shared after you confirm a time.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear options. Option B (Wed Jul 10, 13:00–14:30 PDT) works best for our core team.

Attendees from Orbit Clinic:
- Priya Rao — Program Sponsor (me)
- Anil Menon <anil.menon@orbitclinic.com> — Technical Lead (will own firewall/egress questions)
- Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta.ops@orbitclinic.com> — IT Admin (SSO contact) — pending confirmation but likely to join.

Two asks:
1) Can you include a short 10-minute segment on user provisioning and RBAC patterns specific to Redwood?
2) We need to confirm whether Redwood will require a VPN or if a public endpoint is sufficient for the initial testing phase.

I attached our internal onboarding checklist — let me know if you need anything else ahead of Wed.

Best,
Priya
Director of Digital Health | Orbit Clinic
priya@orbitclinic.com | +1 212-555-0198

Karthik / Jonas —

Priya confirmed Option B (Jul 10, 13:00 PDT). Quick staffing rundown and owner notes so we don't overlap: 
- Monica (me): SSO walk-through, onboarding checklist review, preflight guide (I will own the RBAC/provisioning segment Priya requested, 10m slot).
- Jonas: Product orientation + infra/data access (cover egress vs VPN guidance and required ports).
- Karthik: Sprint0 milestones, mutual action plan and next-step cadences; I suggest you drive the call close and confirm owner-level follow-ups.

I uploaded a tentative calendar invite (calendar-invite-activation-week.ics) to our shared Drive and added the activation playbook. Please review the prework list — I'm flagging the item "sample schema" as optional but helpful.

Also, Jonas — sample question for you to prepare: what size (tokens/sec) baseline should we expect for their initial test dataset? If you can have ballpark numbers we can set expectations.

I'll prepare the slide for RBAC patterns (5–7 bullets) and include screenshots for the Admin Console.
